name: Juggle the Ball

meta.name: Juggle the Ball
meta.tagline: Move the paddle to keep the ball bouncing.
meta.description: Slide the paddle beneath a falling ball and bounce it back into the air. Each catch changes the ball's horizontal motion, while the game gradually gets faster and the paddle gets narrower. Watch the ball's position and velocity to time your next catch.

rewardTerms.description: Fraction of the episode's step limit survived.
Average closeness of the paddle to the ball's predicted landing point while it falls.
Number of times the ball is missed.
Fraction of steps spent moving the paddle.

presets.name: aggressive
presets.description: Prioritize successful catches and aiming for the next one.

presets.name: survivalist
presets.description: Prioritize staying alive and avoid unnecessary movement.

human.hint: Use the left and right arrow keys to slide the paddle under the falling ball.
